metadata.description: Personal plugin marketplace for NotePlan management and productivity tools

plugins.name: discover-oeid-plugins
plugins.description: Discover available personal plugins and see what's installed

plugins.name: config-manager
plugins.description: Manage Claude Code configuration, permissions, and development environment setup

plugins.name: noteplan-manager
plugins.description: Complete NotePlan management suite for templates, organization, analysis, and note creation

plugins.name: script-manager
plugins.description: Create and manage Tampermonkey userscripts with best practices

plugins.name: claude-manager
plugins.description: Manage Claude skills and CLAUDE.md files - create, update, and organize skills across plugins

plugins.name: spirituality-manager
plugins.description: Plan and track spiritual practices - Ramadan schedules, Quran memorization (hifz), and dua routines

plugins.name: knowledge-manager
plugins.description: Extract, map, and query knowledge from notes - transform unstructured content into structured knowledge bases with Zettelkasten-style atomic notes

plugins.name: note-manager
plugins.description: Manage and analyze notes, training materials, and documentation - structure notes, analyze transcripts, clean ebook exports, and generate reference guides

plugins.name: plan-manager
plugins.description: Manage Claude Code plans — inspect quality, move to projects, and produce changelogs

plugins.name: experiment-manager
plugins.description: Structured what-if analysis for validating changes, brainstorming experiments, and designing measurements

plugins.name: code-quality-manager
plugins.description: Improve developer experience through documentation quality, Makefiles, and repo standards

plugins.name: servicenow-manager
plugins.description: ServiceNow-specific tooling: Tampermonkey userscripts for ServiceNow workflows

plugins.name: role-manager
plugins.description: Manage personalbook roles: structure, validate, migrate, reorganize, and archive roles

plugins.name: screenshot-manager
plugins.description: Organize screenshots: prefix directories with dates for chronological sorting, and group related content using macOS Vision OCR

plugins.name: architecture-manager
plugins.description: Generate and maintain architecture artifacts — ERDs, sequence diagrams, C4 diagrams, deployment diagrams, ADRs, and architecture overviews using PlantUML and code-driven rendering

plugins.name: cron-manager
plugins.description: Manage automated background Claude Code tasks — scheduled syncs, cron-style workflows, and periodic maintenance

plugins.name: profile-manager
plugins.description: Manage your profiles — shell environment (browser automation, aliases, setup) and professional profile (resume mission statement, bullet points)

plugins.name: code-repository-manager
plugins.description: Manage code repository documentation — publish co-design docs to GitHub Wiki and GitHub Pages, rebuild navigation, and sync across targets

plugins.name: design-partner
plugins.description: Collaborative design facilitation — build high-level design documents section by section through structured co-authoring

plugins.name: document-co-author
plugins.description: Build presentation decks and structured documents from content specs — separating content from rendering for prompt-driven iteration

plugins.name: local-guide
plugins.description: Be your own local guide — discover businesses near a location and detect whether a company has filed to open at a specific address, using free no-API-key public data (OpenStreetMap + Socrata open-data portals).

plugins.name: consumer
plugins.description: Make durable-good purchase decisions with evidence: weighted decision matrices, honest used-market pricing, price monitoring, and a write-up of the call
